facts.text: The device is an Arduino lock-in amplifier running at a 25 kHz sampling rate with 12-bit analog resolution
The microcontroller generates the reference signal REF_X and acquires the input signal SIG_I
The reference signal REF_X is a true analog-out waveform between 0 and 3.3 V
The upstream Waveform enumeration is Unknown=-1, Sine=0, Square=1 and Triangle=2
Alia.set_ref writes the waveform, frequency, offset, amplitude and RMS amplitude as _wave, _freq, _offs, _ampl and _vrms commands, then reads the obtained values with query_ref
Alia.query_ref sends '?' and parses the waveform, frequency, offset, amplitude, RMS amplitude and the two clipping flags from a tab-separated reply
The firmware derives the reference frequency from the sampling rate as Fs/N_LUT and clamps N_LUT to the allowed look-up-table size
The look-up-table size is clamped between MIN_N_LUT 20 and MAX_N_LUT 1000 samples
The firmware clamps the reference offset, amplitude and RMS amplitude to at least 0.0 V
The firmware sets a clipping flag when the scaled reference waveform falls below 0.0 or above 1.0 of the analog reference
Alia.turn_on writes 'on' and Alia.turn_off writes 'off'; turn_off clears the input buffer and waits for the off acknowledgement
Alia.begin turns the lock-in amplifier off at startup
While the lock-in amplifier is running, the firmware switches it off on any received command, clears the transmit triggers and answers 'off'
On the transition from running to off, the firmware drives the DAC output to 0 V
Alia.query_ADC_autocalibration sends 'autocal?' and stores is_valid, gaincorr and offsetcorr from three tab-separated integers
The firmware reports the ADC calibration as is_valid, gaincorr and offsetcorr
The Alia constructor defaults to 1e6 baud with 1 s read and write timeouts

operator_required.name: ref_freq
operator_required.reason: the firmware derives the output frequency from the sampling rate of the installed board (Fs / N_LUT with N_LUT clamped to 20..1000), so the Hz range differs per board and firmware; the operator supplies the range for this unit
